verdict.rationale: Model-catalog enumeration is a fair axis for an inference platform. However, the evidence pack never documents a GET /v1/models-style list endpoint. The pack only offers general claims of OpenAI-compatible, drop-in APIs and '100+ supported models', and the OpenAI-compatibility claim implies such an endpoint without evidencing it. No OpenAI-style schema was found to confirm one either: all OpenAPI spec paths probed returned 404.
